title: expansao contextual HTML sem layout paginado

forbidden_inputs: private output from implementer or test author
regime.workspace_note: The role used the shared workspace; capability isolation is declared but not attested.

witnesses.setup: A context closure returns visible content and emits one SourceDiagnostic warning named p1421-warning through its execution sink.
The first contextual result contains a ContextBlock that remains residual after the bounded HTML preparation used by P1421.

positive_controls.description: HTML without ContextBlock keeps the pre-P1421 semantic result and selected serialization mode.
A contextual target read is executed under the causal HTML target.
The effective HTML feature collection reaches contextual replay unchanged.
A successful contextual assertion may produce an empty HTML body without being confused with silent marker deletion.
The existing paged target, marker and layout behavior remain unchanged.
A warning from the contextual execution that contributes the published result is returned exactly once.

opaque_controls.description: A contextual HTML read whose stability requires page or position information is outside the proved fragment.
Nested ContextBlocks are not a positive gate of P1421; incomplete preparation cannot be certified.
Ambiguous or colliding contextual producer identity cannot establish a valid HTML preparation attempt.

negative_mutants.mutation: Replace the caller-provided EvalTarget::Html used by contextual execution with EvalTarget::Paged or a Paged default.
negative_mutants.witness: The produced paragraph says paged or the assertion expecting html fails.

negative_mutants.mutation: Rebuild contextual execution with Features::default/empty instead of transporting the effective HTML features from the facade.
negative_mutants.witness: The contextual closure loses access to html.elem and cannot produce the required div morphology.

negative_mutants.mutation: Dispatch the HTML exporter on evaluated content before contextual introspection and preparation, then attempt preparation after serialization.
negative_mutants.witness: The exporter observes ContextBlock first and either emits the baseline unsupported-content error or the boundary trace is reversed.

negative_mutants.mutation: Map ContextBlock directly to Empty/remove it from the HTML view without applying its closure.
negative_mutants.witness: Compilation may appear successful, but the execution count is zero and visible contextual output is absent.

negative_mutants.mutation: Obtain contextual observability by constructing a PagedDocument or calling the paged layout/fixpoint before HTML export.
negative_mutants.witness: At least one forbidden paged construction/layout counter is nonzero even if the final DOM happens to match.

negative_mutants.mutation: Catch an error from contextual execution, substitute Empty or the previous result, and continue to HTML export.
negative_mutants.witness: A successful/partial HTML artifact is emitted or the original p1421-error diagnostic is absent.

negative_mutants.mutation: Discard the sink of the contextual execution whose result is published, or drain it without appending its warning to the facade result.
negative_mutants.witness: Visible content remains but warning count changes from one to zero.

negative_mutants.mutation: Generalize HTML preparation into the paged caller so it uses target Html, removes paged markers, or bypasses the existing paged coordination.
negative_mutants.witness: Paged compilation no longer renders paged, loses the locatable marker, or calls the HTML-only preparation entrypoint.

negative_mutants.mutation: Treat HTML preparation as successful while a ContextBlock remains and dispatch the exporter, or silently strip that residual marker as a fallback.
negative_mutants.witness: The exporter is dispatched, an artifact is emitted, or the residual occurrence disappears without a proved execution.

negative_mutants.mutation: Insert contextual preparation in only one HTML facade/serialization branch, leaving another wrapper to export the unprepared module content or reconstruct target/features/full_error differently.
negative_mutants.witness: At least one public facade differs in DOM, diagnostics, or contextual target beyond its selected encoding/pretty representation.

gate.seal_rule: Any valid negative mutant classified Preserved or Unknown blocks the seal; any positive not Preserved or opaque not Unknown also blocks the seal.
